title: Orbit to Mesh
artwork_alt: Copper-red dragon with a camera on an orbit track
card_description: Turn one image into an AI-generated orbit. Review matched views before Pixal3D builds a mesh. Hi3D and TRELLIS.2 finish the asset.
card_credits: Powered by MiniMax H3, Pruna P-H3 Image, Pablo Dawson’s orbit LoRA and Pixal3D from Tencent ARC Lab, Tsinghua University and Victoria University of Wellington.
tip: Use a clear reference of one subject. Check the orbit for changes in shape and details before building the mesh.
preset_standard_help: 768 × 768 with Turbo. The longer orbit gives camera alignment more frames to work with.
preset_low_vram_help: 512 × 512 with Turbo. Use this when GPU memory is tight.
preset_full_steps_help: 768 × 768, 28 steps, Turbo off. Try this for a short orbit with the standard sampler.
missing_tools: Camera alignment needs {files}. Install COLMAP to continue.
use_image: Use image in Orbit to Mesh
orbit_review_help: When the orbit looks consistent, align its cameras to find useful mesh views.
frame_review_help: Keep the front and at least one other view. Uncheck views with blur, warped details, or missing parts.
mesh_review_help: Check the rough shape before finishing. Hi3D uses the original reference to refine it, then Foundry cleans and textures the mesh.
aligning: Aligning cameras from the masked orbit
refining: Refining and cleaning the mesh with Hi3D
texturing: Texturing the clean mesh with TRELLIS.2
help_camera_calibration: Fit one shared focal length, or hold it at the chosen field of view.
help_fov: Starting horizontal field of view in degrees. Fixed mode uses it as the exact lens.
help_features: Maximum features per frame. More features can help alignment and increase processing time.
help_gpu: Use the GPU to find and match image features.
help_timeout: Maximum minutes allowed for camera alignment.
help_preset: Choose how many evenly spaced views to propose. Eight is experimental and can use more memory.
help_front: Source frame for the front of the mesh. Use -1 for the earliest registered frame.
help_angle: Reject proposed views farther than this many degrees from their target.
help_sharpness: Prefer sharper frames within this many degrees of the closest candidate. Use zero to choose by angle only.
help_resolution: Geometry detail resolution. Higher settings take more GPU memory.
help_seed: Change the seed to generate a different mesh from the same views.
help_shift: Shift the structure sampling schedule. Higher values favor earlier structure decisions.
help_pixal_steps: Denoising iterations for this pass. More iterations take longer.
help_pixal_cfg: How strongly this pass follows the selected image views.
help_intake: Reduce a copy of the rough mesh to this triangle limit before Hi3D. The saved rough mesh stays available.
help_cleanup: Voxel resolution used when open geometry needs repair.
help_texture_size: Texture and bake size in pixels. Larger maps use more memory.
help_texture_mode: Use standard TRELLIS.2 sampling or the shorter SMD recipe.
help_texture_steps: Standard TRELLIS.2 sampling iterations. SMD uses its own fixed settings.
help_texture_cfg: How strongly standard texturing follows the reference image.
help_texture_seed: Change the seed for a different texture.
sheet_sampler: Sampler for the four-view image sheet.
sheet_sigmas: The sheet's noise schedule as descending comma-separated values from 1 to 0.
sheet_shift: Shift the image model's noise schedule.
sheet_tile: Decode the sheet in tiles. Smaller tiles reduce peak VRAM.
orbit_denoise: Fraction of the noise schedule used for the orbit.
orbit_chunk: Minimum sequence size for splitting feed-forward work.
orbit_tile_overlap: Pixels shared between video decoder tiles. More overlap can reduce seams.
orbit_time_overlap: Frames shared between decoder batches. More overlap can reduce changes between batches.
help_refine_res: Hi3D mesh detail resolution. Higher settings cost GPU memory.
help_refine_steps: Hi3D iterations. More iterations take longer.
help_refine_seed: Change the seed to try a different refinement.
help_cpu: Move inactive Hi3D modules to system RAM when supported to save VRAM.
help_attention: Attention backend used by the existing Hi3D runtime.
help_sigmas_invalid: Use descending sheet sigmas between 1 and 0, ending at 0.
help_overlap_invalid: Decoder overlap must be at most half the tile or batch size.
help_pixal_sampler: Sampling algorithm for this Pixal3D pass.
help_pixal_scheduler: Noise schedule for this Pixal3D pass.
help_pixal_denoise: Fraction of the noise schedule used for this pass.
help_band: Thickness of the remeshing surface band in voxels.
help_smoothing: Extra smoothing passes when remeshing open geometry. More can soften detail.
help_project_back: Pull the remeshed surface toward the input surface. Zero leaves the voxel surface unchanged.
help_texture_sampler: Sampler used by standard TRELLIS.2 texturing. SMD uses its own recipe.
help_guidance_rescale: Rescale texture guidance to moderate strong color shifts.
help_reference_lock: Increase to keep the painted texture closer to the reference image.
help_reference_substeps: Number of substeps when locking the texture to the reference.
help_cage_distance: Ray distance around the reduced mesh when baking normals.
help_ignore_backfaces: Skip faces pointing away from a baking ray to avoid sampling the opposite side.
help_grounding: Level the support surface, place the asset on the floor, or keep its original orientation.
help_texture_triangles: Limit triangles sent to texturing and UV unwrapping. The clean master is preserved. Zero uses the full mesh.
